strings: When r_c0 notices that m_c looks very tired recently {PRONOUN/r_c0/subject}{VERB/m_c/'re/'s} worry is only made worse when the answer is constant nightmares.
m_c feels cursed, the shadowy creatures that make {PRONOUN/m_c/object} frozen and incapable have found their way into permanent residence in m_c's head.
